user_story: As a user, I want to browse products in a mobile viewport using a burger menu so that I can easily navigate through the available items. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can open the menu by clicking the button with id 'react-burger-menu-btn'. 2. The user can see the 'All Items' link in the menu with data-test 'inventory-sidebar-link'. 3. The user can close the menu by clicking the button with id 'react-burger-cross-btn'.
